title: Critical Ultrarelativistic Black-Hole Collision Solutions
exact_target: Is there a unique threshold geometry for high-energy black-hole collisions, and which proposed approximations describe it?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30002147 (OWR-12009-003). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Mathematical Aspects of General Relativity (2012), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2012/37, pp. 2269--2333. Primary report accessed 2026-10-11; relevant PDF pages 31, 32, 33.
Klein, helical binary spacetimes (catalogue-listed context; not independently consulted in this preparation).
Healy--Ciarfella--Lousto, high-speed collisions (catalogue-listed context; not independently consulted in this preparation).

status_qualification: This is a numerical and analytical research programme. The source target leaves the limiting family, normalization and uniqueness notion to its collision model; no existence theorem for an unspecified class of initial data is asserted.
